title: 🚨 PASTOR, THE CHURCH SHOULD NOT GET THE BEST OF YOU WHILE YOUR SPOUSE GETS WHAT’S LEFT.
paragraphs: 🚨 PASTOR, THE CHURCH SHOULD NOT GET THE BEST OF YOU WHILE YOUR SPOUSE GETS WHAT’S LEFT.
You can preach powerful sermons…
Counsel hurting people.
Answer every message.
Show up for every emergency.
Build a growing ministry.
And still come home to a marriage that is quietly starving.
That should concern every pastor and ministry leader.
Because ministry success does not excuse marital neglect.

HOW TO PROTECT YOUR MARRIAGE WHILE PASTORING
Guarding Your Covenant, Loving Your Spouse, and Leading the Church Without Losing Your Home
Pastoring creates a dangerous tension few people talk about:
Everyone needs you.
The church needs you.
Your leaders need you.
Hurting people need you.
But while you're constantly available to everyone else, the person you promised to love for life may slowly begin receiving only your exhaustion.
This book was written to confront that pattern—and help pastors protect both their calling and their covenant.
🔥 INSIDE, YOU’LL DISCOVER:

• How to recognize when ministry is quietly consuming your marriage
• Why your spouse should never be treated like an unpaid ministry employee
• How the desire to feel “needed” can become spiritually dangerous
• Biblical boundaries for counseling, messages, emergencies, and church demands
• How to guard against emotional affairs and inappropriate relationships
• How to stop giving the congregation your best while giving your family your leftovers
• How to walk with your spouse through church hurt, criticism, and betrayal
• Practical ways to rebuild friendship, intimacy, communication, prayer, and connection
• How to pastor faithfully without sacrificing your home on the altar of ministry
⚔️ MOST PEOPLE VS. FEW PEOPLE
Most people measure ministry by crowds.
Few ask what ministry is doing to their marriage.
Most celebrate the pastor who is always available.
Few see the spouse waiting at home.
Most protect their preaching schedule.
Few protect their marriage with the same determination.
Most want a powerful ministry.
Few understand that character at home matters when nobody is applauding.
Pastor, your spouse is not competing with God's calling on your life.
Loving your spouse faithfully is part of walking obediently before God.
“But as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.” — Joshua 24:15

The Library is being built as a growing discipleship vault filled with Christian books and resources designed to strengthen believers in biblical truth, repentance, prayer, discipline, marriage, spiritual growth, identity in Christ, and faithful living.
And there’s another benefit:
If honoring God, strengthening believers, and helping the Word reach more people matters to you, this is one practical way you can stand with the mission.
⚔️ THIS IS BIGGER THAN ONE BOOK.
We are building a movement of believers who don't merely consume Christian content.
We want to live it.
Stronger marriages.
Stronger families.
Stronger disciples.
Stronger churches.
Not for our glory.
For Christ.
🔥 PASTORS. MINISTRY LEADERS. BELIEVERS WHO WANT TO HELP BUILD THIS MISSION:
Then do three things:

Protect the covenant.
Guard your home.
Love your spouse well.
Serve Christ faithfully.

⚔️ GOSPEL WARRIOR
Read. Grow. Be Equipped. Make a Difference.
